question: 最近30天销售额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) LIMIT 1000

question: 今年销售额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-01-01') AND order_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-01-01') + INTERVAL 1 YEAR LIMIT 1000

question: 去年销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-01-01') - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND order_date < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-01-01') LIMIT 1000

question: 本月订单量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单量 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') AND order_date <= NOW() LIMIT 1000

question: 最近90天订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单量 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY) LIMIT 1000

question: 本周订单量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单量 FROM orders WHERE YEARWEEK(order_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) LIMIT 1000

question: 完成的订单
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

question: 成交金额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

question: 销量超过平均销量的商品
sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT id, name, 销量 FROM product_sales WHERE 销量 > (SELECT AVG(销量) FROM product_sales) LIMIT 1000

question: 对比一下 top5
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 销量排名前
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各地区的情况
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders GROUP BY region LIMIT 1000

question: 成交总额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS completed_total FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

question: 已完成的订单总额
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

question: 钻石等级客户买的家居类商品总金额
sql: SELECT TRUNCATE(SUM(o.amount),2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE c.level='钻石' AND p.category='家居' LIMIT 1000

question: 本月数码类商品的销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = '数码' AND o.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND o.order_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) LIMIT 1000
